title: orchestrator · Assign manager to benchmark dynamic vs. static memory under fixed toke
summary: Assign manager to benchmark dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets using LongMemEval.
body: Previous loops failed to compare dynamic consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only Markdown) under identical token constraints, leaving the 'superiority' hypothesis unverified. Sources lacked controlled experiments matching specific resource limits. We must now target a reproducible benchmark like LongMemEval to empirically measure task success and hallucination rates at fixed token budgets, limiting scope to 4 sources to ensure completion within the active research window.
